verdict.rationale: Rootly documents an official MCP server and REST API that can create incidents, query on-call/escalation data, and 'take action' from IDEs like Cursor/Claude Code (rootly-docs-22/31/33/44), plus API key roles scoped to 'On-Call and Incident Response' (rootly-docs-49) and incident creation via API (rootly-docs-11). However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates acknowledge/escalate/resolve as discrete MCP tools or API endpoints, and the openapi probe returned 404s, leaving the full incident-lifecycle claim only implied rather than concretely documented end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP documentation of acknowledge, escalate, and resolve actions, a working OpenAPI/schema reference, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can run the full loop without dashboard involvement.
